summary: @servicetitan/standalone-feature-flags preinstall downloads Bun runtime and executes obfuscated sibling payload
details: package.json declares `preinstall: node setup.mjs`. setup.mjs is obfuscated and, at `npm install` time, constructs a URL of the form https://github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases/download/bun-v1.3.13/<archive>.zip, downloads and extracts the Bun runtime binary to a temp directory, chmods it executable, then invokes it via execFileSync against a sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a 727 KB single-line JavaScript file with rotating string-array obfuscation (`WV8StW` push/shift deobfuscator over a >2000-entry mixed constant table) and hex-mangled identifiers (`_0x...`, `_0x19328d`); it is not imported by the library's `dist/index.js`, does not appear in `src/`, and has no relationship to the package's advertised OpenFeature feature-flag wrapper purpose. The only path that reaches `math_init.js` is the preinstall hook launching it under the freshly downloaded Bun binary. This is an alternate-runtime dropper: fetching a non-Node runtime to execute a bundled, undeclared, heavily obfuscated payload with full host privileges at install time, evading Node-based scanners.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
